title: Grateful Dead Live at Community Concourse on 1970-01-10
lineage: RX > Technics RS-1506 > Grace Design Lunatec V3 [Pre-Only] > Korg MR-1000 > DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] > Korg AudioGate > wav [24/96]
source: MR > R1 > RX (purported to be 2nd gen)

ai_review.summary: Fair soundboard recording with nostalgic garble but standout performances of Good Lovin' and Lovelight
ai_review.review: The tape shows its age with occasional garbled sections, yet the latter part of the concert comes alive – Good Lovin' pounds out a punch‑filled groove and Lovelight shines with high‑voltage Jerry guitar work and soulful Pigpen vocals. The show’s magic outweighs the modest audio flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Review praises the musical performance (especially Good Lovin' and Lovelight) while noting recording is garbled; weighted average yields a solid 4‑star rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audio shows age, some garbled/muddy passages, but improves toward the end where it sounds fresher.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall nostalgic vibe with a strong finish; early parts are less vivid, but the ending delivers classic Dead magic.

band_member_comments.Jerry: High‑voltage, unique guitar work on Lovelight.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's voice described as strong and soulful, adding to the magic.
